mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, which lowers discount rates on equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances during easing periods, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than a baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a contractionary monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the effect diminishes in subsequent months despite sustained high rates.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly employment (HOUST) signal robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies meet thresholds, or the correlation between proxies and returns is < 0.3 over a 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods of UNRATE < 3.5%, or the 60d returns are consistently below the 5-year average during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Falling unemployment rates below 3.5% signal a strengthening labor market, which supports corporate growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 3.5%, or the effect diminishes in subsequent months despite sustained low rates.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, amplifying investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies meet thresholds, or the interaction effect's IC < 0.25 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated discount rates suppress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 50% of tightening periods, or the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicates economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed thresholds, or the IC between proxies and returns is < 0.2 over a 3-year period.
